title: Greetings in the Evening
subject: English Language
objectives: Greet people politely in the evening
Use 'good night' when saying goodbye at night

blocks.md: In the **evening**, we greet people by saying **'Good evening'**. When it is time to leave or go to bed, we say **'Good night'**.

blocks.alt: A teacher with pupils in football kits in the evening
blocks.caption: The teacher and pupils play football in the evening.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Are you all ready to play football?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Let us choose our team captains first.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Akpan, pick five boys for your team.

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Did you all enjoy the game today?

lines.speaker: Teacher
lines.text: Good night, children. See you all tomorrow.

blocks.md: **Remember:** We say **'Good evening'** when we meet someone in the evening. But when we are leaving or going to bed, we say **'Good night'**.

quiz.q: What do you say when you see someone in the evening?
quiz.explain: In the evening we say 'Good evening'.

quiz.q: What do you say before going to bed?
quiz.explain: We say 'Good night' when going to bed or leaving at night.

quiz.q: What game did the pupils play in the evening?
quiz.explain: The teacher asked if they were ready to play football.
The teacher asked Akpan first to pick five boys for his team.
